column1: # The prompts cogwork's sounds were made from, for tools/sfx.sh: one sound per line, its files
# going to assets/sounds/<file><n>.ogg for n = 1..variants. Columns, separated by tabs:
# file, variants, seconds, prompt influence (0-1), prompt (450 characters at most).

column5: Single stroke of a small wooden piston engine driven by a coiled steel spring: soft wooden creak, a firm thunk and a light ratchet click. Close up, dry, isolated game sound effect, no music.

One stroke of a heavy industrial steam engine: a deep, weighty thump of a big iron piston and crankshaft, clanking connecting rod and valve gear, then a hissing chuff of exhaust steam. Large factory machinery, low and powerful. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Coal catching fire in a small iron firebox: a soft whoosh of flame swelling, then crackling embers. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Overheated steam engine cutting out: a sharp hiss from a pressure valve, hot metal ticking and a short shrill warning whistle. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Iron engine cooling down after overheating: metal pings and ticks as it contracts, then a short soft hiss of relief. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Short wooden suction thup as a small object is sucked into a glass tube and slides away. Close up, dry, isolated game sound effect, no music.
A small object vanishing in a muffled vacuum pop with a tiny fizzle. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Clunk and rattle as a stuck object is ejected from a glass pipe and drops out. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Iron beam clanking into place on a scaffold frame, followed by a quick bolt ratchet. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A colossal mining machine drilling deep underground: the heavy, low-pitched rumbling drone of a giant rotating drill head and grinding iron gears, deep crunching of rock, a sound felt more than heard. No high-pitched whine, no small power tool. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Big clockwork machine finishing its work: heavy gears spinning down and slowing, then a deep final clunk as it settles. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Small brass clockwork machine finishing a craft: gears turning, a press stamping down and a tidy mechanical ding. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.
Machine-driven shovel blade scraping through earth and loose dirt in one short stroke. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
A block of earth pressed down into a hole with a firm thud and a tamp. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Wrench ratchet turning a bolt: three quick metallic clicks. Close up, dry, isolated game sound effect, no music.
A surveying instrument measuring out an area: a soft electric hum rising into a glassy shimmer and a light chime. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Very soft, short glassy tick, a subtle user interface click. Isolated, no music.

A heavy steel auger boring straight down through rock beneath a machine: grinding and crunching stone, the low whir of a motor and gearbox turning the bit. Large heavy machinery, low and weighty. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

One stroke of a big iron pump drawing thick oil up a long pipe from deep underground: a deep suction gulp, a heavy valve clunk and a slow gurgling glug of thick liquid. Large machinery, low and weighty. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

One stroke of a small wooden hand pump with a paddle wheel: a soft wooden creak of the wheel turning and a short watery glug of liquid pushed through a pipe. Small, close up, dry, isolated game sound effect, no music.

One power stroke of an enormous slow oil engine as big as a room: a single thunderous, chest-shaking bass explosion in a huge iron cylinder, with the heavy clank of its piston and a hard bark of exhaust, dying away into the low growl of a massive flywheel. Punchy, very loud, very low and weighty, close up. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

One turn of a heavy round millstone ground by hand on a stone bed: a low gritty rumble of stone grinding over stone with crunching wet sand and ore, a dull wooden creak of the handle. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.

A wooden sieve with a string mesh shaken hard once by hand: loose gravel and small stones rattling and rasping across the mesh, a short hiss of sand falling through, a light wooden knock. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.

A wooden drilling rig boring into rock: heavy timber beams creaking and groaning under strain, a rope-bound wooden shaft turning, and a stone drill bit grinding and crunching through stone below. Low, rough and rustic, no engine, no metal whine. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
A heavy wooden log pole set down into place with a solid hollow knock, then rope pulled tight and knotted round it with a short rough rasp. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.

A large old wooden water wheel turning slowly in a stream: a long deep groaning creak of a wet timber axle in its bearing, water splashing off the paddles and trickling down. Low and weighty. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
Winding up a big clockwork spring by hand with a crank: a quick run of firm metallic ratchet clicks and the tight creak of the spring tensioning. Close up, dry, isolated game sound effect, no music.

A large engine-driven shaker screen sifting crushed rock: a heavy iron mesh tray jolting fast back and forth on stiff springs, gravel and stones rattling and bouncing across the steel mesh, sand hissing through into a wooden pan, a deep thrumming knock of the drive underneath. Big, loud, low and weighty industrial machinery. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A big engine-driven grinding mill: a heavy granite millstone turning steadily on an iron spindle in a wooden tub, a deep low rumbling grind of stone over stone crushing ore in wet sand, the creak and knock of wooden gearing above. Loud, bass-heavy, weighty industrial machinery. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A large leather bellows pumped once: the soft creak of its wooden boards and leather folds, then a deep breathy whoosh of air forced out through an iron nozzle into a coal fire, which flares with a low roar. Close up, isolated game sound effect, no music.

A wooden paddle wheel turning in a trough of water and ore: wet oak blades slapping and churning the water, heavy sloshing and splashing, gravel and wet stones tumbling and grinding against the boards, an iron axle creaking in its bearings. Mid-sized machine, full and watery with some low weight. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A big brick blast furnace roaring under forced air: a deep, steady, bass-heavy roar of a white-hot coke fire as bellows blast air in through iron nozzles, a low rumbling thrum, flames whooshing up a tall brick stack, crackling and spitting sparks. Huge, loud and weighty, felt in the chest. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A heavy blacksmith's hammer striking a glowing hot steel bloom on a big iron anvil: one hard, ringing metallic clang with a deep thud of the anvil's mass under it, a short bright ring dying away and a faint sizzle of sparks. Loud, close up. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

One exhaust chuff of a big stationary steam engine: a deep, heavy, bass-heavy puff of steam blasting out of a large iron cylinder, the thump of a heavy piston reversing and the clank of its crosshead and connecting rod, the weight of a big iron flywheel rolling underneath. Loud, low and powerful industrial machinery. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A massive steam drop hammer: a huge iron ram slamming down onto a glowing steel bloom on an anvil with an enormous deep, booming, bass-heavy thud that shakes the ground like a pile driver, a short heavy metallic clank on top, then a brief hiss of exhaust steam. Very loud and low, felt in the chest. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A riveted iron steam boiler over a coal fire: a steady hiss of steam escaping a safety valve, the deep low rumble of water boiling inside a big iron drum, a few ticks and pings of hot metal. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A big steel flotation tank of thick grey slurry, a heavy motor-driven rotor churning underneath: deep, bass-heavy glugging and burping of large air bubbles rising through mud, frothy foam crackling and popping on top, a low steady churn of the stirring impeller. Loud, low, wet industrial machinery. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

One turn of a hand-cranked steel core drill boring into hard rock: a heavy iron gear ratcheting round, then a deep, gritty grinding scrape of a diamond-tipped rod biting into stone below, crunching rock chips. Close up, weighty but hand-worked. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A tall steel oil refinery distillation column at work: a deep, heavy, bass-heavy rumble of hot oil boiling inside a big riveted steel tower, a low roaring burner underneath, thick liquid gurgling through trays and pipes, a slow throb of the whole column. Loud, low and powerful industrial machinery, felt in the chest. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A big steel relief valve on top of an overheated refinery column blowing off hot gas: a loud, forceful hiss of vapour rushing out of a pipe, with a deep low whoosh underneath and a rattle of the valve. Powerful industrial release. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A big sealed steel chemical reactor at work: thick hot liquid bubbling and glugging inside a riveted steel vessel, deep bass-heavy blub-blub of large bubbles bursting, a low steady hum of a heater underneath and a faint hiss from a vent pipe. Loud, low, wet industrial machinery. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A huge hydraulic molding press stamping once: a short rising hiss of hydraulic oil, then a massive deep bass-heavy thump as a heavy steel ram slams down onto a steel mold, a dull metallic clunk and a low shudder of the machine frame, then a soft hiss as it lifts. Very loud and low, felt in the chest. Isolated game sound effect, no music.

A heavy steel revolver drum in a machine turning a quarter and locking: a firm mechanical ratchet clack, a thick drill bit sliding out of a steel sleeve and a new one clunking into a chuck with a solid metallic thunk. Close up, weighty. Isolated game sound effect, no music.
